lean.statement: ∀ {E : Type u} [NormedAddCommGroup E] [InnerProductSpace ℝ E] [FiniteDimensional ℝ E] [MeasurableSpace E] [BorelSpace E] [SecondCountableTopology E] [StandardBorelSpace E] [Nonempty E] {γ : Measure (E × E)} {μ₀ μ₁ : Measure E} [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₀] [IsProbabilityMeasure μ₁], Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ 2) μ₀ → Integrable (fun x : E => ‖x‖ ^ 2) μ₁ → IsQuadraticOptimalCoupling γ μ₀ μ₁ → ∀ {s t : ℝ}, 0 ≤ s → s ≤ t → t ≤ 1 → wassersteinDistance (displacementInterpolation γ s) (displacementInterpolation γ t) = ENNReal.ofReal (t - s) * wassersteinDistance μ₀ μ₁
approved_definition_context: A quadratic optimal coupling is a measure on pairs whose two marginals are the endpoint measures and whose integral of the squared norm of the coordinate difference attains the quadratic transport-cost infimum.
The displacement interpolation at a real parameter r is the pushforward of the coupling by the measurable affine map sending a pair (x,y) to (1-r)x+ry.

The Wasserstein distance used here takes values in the nonnegative extended reals. ENNReal.ofReal sends a real number to its nonnegative extended-real embedding. Integrable is real-valued Bochner integrability with respect to the displayed measure.
